Posts.RecruitPostName: Design Producer
Posts.Responsibility:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
About this position at Lightspeed Studios
The Design Producer is responsible for producing design content within the incredible world we are building. They will ensure the smooth running of each feature by facilitating communication and information sharing between designers, engineers, department leads, and other stakeholders. The Design Producer is also expected to give ideas and lead the team to implement. They will be responsible for establishing processes and building relationships with outside studios as well. They need to work with other producers to ensure the success of the project.
Responsibilities:
Multi-disciplinary work within the game team with some exposure to external groups
Suggest and develop design ideas and lead the development team to implement
Responsible for planning and scheduling of broad discipline and major feature teams
Coordinates tasking and status of assigned team(s) for short- and long-term deadlines--sprints & milestones
Works with senior leadership on coordinating the project goal
Help improve production goals, standards, and policies for production while also developing policies that improve the production process
Elevate the production team by providing mentorship and guidance
Use leadership skills to influence, motivate, and encourage the team

Who We Look For
5+ years of game production experience in various production discipline roles
Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills
Experience working closely with design teams to develop game design ideas
Thorough understanding of inter-departmental workflows and dependencies
Thorough understanding of the game development process
Expertise in documentation and communication tools
Strong proficiency with various production methodologies and project management tools
Advanced to Expert conflict resolution skills
Demonstrated leadership with cross disciplinary teams
Self-starter, comfortable working with new teams and new pipelines within a start-up environment
Comfortable creating structure with minimal direction
Able to assess project risk quickly and drive solutions
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Pluses:
Love of video games and game design
Passion for ARPGs

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: New Zealand-Auckland | China-Shanghai | China-Shenzhen
